g.text: call by name; cards come back

text.style: fill: #444444; font: italic 7.4px 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Reading: the human supplies and decides; the agents route the work through skills to tools; tools compute and come back as descriptor cards; the planner stops at every checkpoint and the human picks. Nothing the agents say is a number they computed.
and names the product A* + B*;
the five checkpoints where the agent waits:
❚❚ pick up to five final states
choice and reason go to the case bank;
only a human promotes a case to a skill;
with HPC, dft-recovery-agent retries a failed
LLM agents: plan, propose, draft; never compute, never place atoms
the next tool call and when to stop; holds the
checkpoint list; calls every tool by name, reads
which published values and sources to put before
the human: E_ads with functional and site, and
d, the length of the bond to break
which protocol and settings to propose for the
lock, from the Formulate interview and the
which site types and orderings to try per
fragment, from the chemistry of the broken bond;
never a coordinate, never an override
which potential to use, and whether to trust,
repair or escalate on the calibrated doubt
whether the plan and the report hold up, judged
in its own context before the human sees them

text.style: fill: #0e7490; font: italic 6.8px 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: hooks: no coordinate edits; a pause at every checkpoint
Skills the agents follow, written by humans:
ours: dft-settings-protocol · mlip-doubt-calibration · dissociation-final-state · final-state-report · hpc-dft-jobs
reused from AtomisticSkills: ml-committee-uncertainty · ml-mlip-benchmark · ml-mace-finetune · chem-thermochemistry · general-peer-review
Tools, deterministic code under src/fragplace/tools/<category>.py, each wrapping one module of fragplace/; the planner calls them by name, in this order:

g.text: extensions: dft_single_points, only if D2 allows DFT; active_learning · every tool returns its structure as a descriptor card and logs every parameter beside its output
The architecture: the human at both ends, 6 LLM agents that only plan, propose and draft, the skills they follow, 17 tools that do every calculation
board of 21 October 2026 · arrows are calls and hand-offs · every number the agents report is a tool output · hooks block coordinate edits and pause at the checkpoints
